name: go-github-coherent-entity-snapshot-cache
instr:
go-github cannot currently reuse coherent, decoded snapshots across repeated GitHub user, organization, and Copilot Space reads. Add an opt-in entity snapshot cache. Without it, requests, responses, decoding, pagination, errors, and concrete Copilot Space owners must remain unchanged. Equivalent lookups must converge without mixing entity kinds, owners, or incomplete identities.

Every hit must return a fully detached snapshot, including nested pointers, slices, metadata, and concrete owners. Canonical identities and learned aliases share one snapshot within an entity kind; incomplete identities create no speculative aliases. Named, numeric, and authenticated User reads and name and numeric Organization reads learn only aliases justified by decoded identity. Embedded summaries may teach identities but must not replace fuller snapshots with missing fields.

Isolate Copilot Space list, get, create, and update results by organization owner and space number. Successful decoding records dependencies on concrete User or Organization owners. Successful user updates, organization edits or deletion, and organization-scoped team or repository mutations invalidate the entity, its aliases, and dependent spaces. Failures and partial bodies leave reusable state unchanged.
